note: Size 1 has its own base model (activity names differ from sizes 2-5), so the name-based conventions of the E0 rule (o* partner, o1 anchor, p5.. sibling) do not apply. The same conventions are applied by ROLE, read from the trace variants before/after (compare_sizes12345.csv, inspection printed in README). Proposed by Claude 2026-11-13, to be confirmed by the author.

ConditionalMove.reason: n o p -> o XOR(n, p): n is the moved activity; p is the partner branch (presence 1 -> 0.5), optional as the o* partner in sizes 2-5 (e.g. o11 in size 3, presence also changes); o is the neighbour

ConditionalRemoval.reason: re is removed from a conditional branch; r: loop-region fluctuation (s r s 0.06 -> 0.10), not part of the change; drift 2 projection gives re only

ConditionalToSequence.reason: p XOR q -> p q: both presences 0.5 -> 1; the name-based sibling convention (p5..) has no counterpart; FLAG for author: if one of p, q is regarded as the sibling branch it becomes optional

ParallelMove.both_sources: rule n, p (pred+succ changed); projection n
ParallelMove.reason: n o p -> o AND(n, p): n is moved; p is the parallel partner (optional as o* partner in sizes 2-5); o neighbour

ParallelRemoval.both_sources: rule re, z1 (pred+succ changed); projection re
ParallelRemoval.reason: AND(re, z1) -> z1: re removed; z1 is the parallel partner (optional as in sizes 2-5)

ParallelToSequence.reason: AND(n, o) -> n o: both branches, as in the size-3 author reference

Skip.reason: n becomes skippable; o is the re-entry anchor (o1 in sizes 2-5)

Swap.both_sources: n, o, p (projection: any two of three suffice)
Swap.reason: n o p -> p o n: n and p are swapped; o keeps its position between them (neighbours change only)
